🚀 We're Hiring: Node.js Developer (1–2 Years Exp.)
Company: Bitrupt
Location: Saddar, Karachi (Near Press Club) – On-site

The Role
We aren't looking for a corporate robot. We need a rising backend builder who lives in Node.js, breathes APIs, and is ready to write code that actually impacts real products. If you have 1 to 2 years of solid experience and love solving puzzles behind the screen, let’s talk.

Database Comfort: You can talk to MongoDB or SQL databases without breaking a sweat.
API Crafting: You build clean, secure, and fast RESTful APIs.
Problem-Solving: You don't just find bugs; you crush them.

Why Bitrupt?
Work right in the heart of Karachi (Saddar), easily accessible from anywhere.
Fast-paced environment with zero corporate red tape.
Massive room for quick professional and financial growth.

Drop Your Specs!

📞 WhatsApp / Call: 0303-2518858

Job Title: Backend Developer

Let's build something amazing together!

Job Title: Node.js Developer
Location: Karachi
Company: AimNode Technologies
Job Type: Full-time

Job Description:
We are seeking a talented Node.js Developer to join our team. As a Node.js Developer, you will be responsible for designing and implementing server-side web application logic, as well as integrating user-facing elements developed by front-end developers. You should have a strong understanding of JavaScript and asynchronous programming. The ideal candidate is passionate about building scalable, high-performance web applications using Node.js and related technologies.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and maintain server-side logic using Node.js
- Design and implement RESTful APIs for web services
- Collaborate with front-end developers to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic
- Optimize application performance for maximum speed and scalability
- Implement security and data protection measures
- Write clean, maintainable, and testable code
- Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and best practices

Requirements:
- Proven experience as a Node.js Developer or similar role
- Strong proficiency in JavaScript and asynchronous programming
- Experience with Node.js frameworks such as Express.js or Koa.js
- Knowledge of database technologies such as MongoDB, MySQL, or PostgreSQL
- Familiarity with front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
- Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git)
- Excellent problem-solving and communication skills
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (preferred)

How to Apply:
Interested candidates should submit their resume, along with a cover letter detailing their relevant experience and why they are a good fit for the position. Please also include links to any relevant portfolios or projects. Applications can be sent to devawaisdeveloper@gmail.com with the subject line "Node.js Developer."

Waiting for your OASIS+ award? Here’s this week’s DISH. 🍽️
You submitted. You answered clarifications. You checked your email. And then checked it again.

So, is GSA making progress?

Over six weeks,
October 1–November 15
, GSA published
72 announcement entries
across all six OASIS+ contract families:
🔴
24 new-award entries
—about
4 per week
.
🔴
48 domain additions
—about
7 per week
.
🔴
72 total entries
—about
11 per week
For those awaiting a
new award
, those 24 entries included:
🔴 Small Business:
12
🔴 WOSB:
5
🔴 SDVOSB:
3
🔴 HUBZone:
2
🔴 Unrestricted:
2
🔴 8(a):
0 during this window
What might the timeline look like?
Here’s one
Mild Red client’s
experience:
📅
March 30:
Proposal submitted.
📅
October 12:
Request for clarification received.
📅
November 4:
Apparent-awardee announcement.
📅
November 12:
Contract award.
📅
November 17:
Listed in GSA eLibrary!

That’s
219 days from submission to apparent awardee
, including
23 days from the clarification request to the announcement
. The contract award and eLibrary listing followed within
13 days of the announcement
.

Approximately seven months of waiting—and then a lot happened in the final few weeks.
My planning recommendation:
Be ready to respond when clarifications arrive, and allow approximately
two weeks after the apparent-awardee announcement for award and eLibrary listing
. That’s a planning reference based on this client’s experience, not a guaranteed timeline.

Keep watching
OASIS+ Award Announcements
under GSA’s continuously open solicitations page, then check
GSA eLibrary
for your listing.

The awards are coming in dribs and drabs. For those refreshing their inboxes, I hope these numbers provide a little perspective—and a reason to keep getting ready.
#OASISPlus
#GovCon
#MildRedLLC
